what: PPL is a regulated utility holding company. It delivers electricity in Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Virginia and Rhode Island, delivers gas in Kentucky and Rhode Island, and generates electricity in Kentucky.
customers: Households, businesses and industrial users across four states.
money: electricity delivery to about 1.4 million customers
moat: Delivery monopolies in each state, with returns set by regulators and demand that holds up through economic cycles.
risks: Return on invested capital of about 5%, normal for a regulated utility
Rate case decisions determine recoverable investment
Kentucky generation requires capital to meet emissions rules
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year with a 24% operating margin
Data centre requests in Pennsylvania and Kentucky raise long-term demand
Analysts see about 16% upside from current levels
watch: Data centre connection agreements and rate case outcomes.
